title: QuickLinks - link-in-bio page builder
description: Simple Linktree alternative built with Flask + Tailwind. 850 registered creators, 23 on the $2/mo pro tier. Runs on a single $5 VPS, fully automated signups and billing via Stripe. I have two kids now and zero time; priced to sell.

title: InvoiceFox - dead-simple invoicing for freelancers
description: Node/Express + React invoicing tool. 3,400 signups, ~200 monthly active, $95 MRR from a $5/mo plan. SEO brings 6k visits/mo for 'free invoice generator' queries. Needs maybe 3 hrs/wk. Selling because I got acquired-hired and can't run a paid product.

title: WordHabit - daily vocabulary PWA with 12k installs
description: Progressive web app teaching a word a day with spaced repetition. 12,000 installs, 1,900 DAU, no revenue yet but an obvious $1/mo premium path. Pure TypeScript + Svelte, static hosting, near-zero costs. Great fit for someone who wants users first, monetization second.
